image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a tiger beetle on a sandy or light-colored rocky surface. The beetle has a dark, metallic body (appearing purple/bronze) with distinct cream-colored spots on its elytra. It features long, slender legs and very long, thin antennae. The head is visible with large eyes.
